title: Target
description: A target injected for authorized security testing. Mirrors services/api/src/api/models.py::Target.

authorization_note.description: Program name, ticket link, or ownership statement. Required, recorded for audit, not independently verified.

passive_only.description: When true, the orchestrator never sends a request to this target - only third-party OSINT (Shodan/Censys) runs. Must be explicitly disabled per-target.
